name: Tonpa Shenrab
notes: Early Age of Machinery, around or shortly after Year 2,200. He negotiates among highland assemblies, caravan towns and the emerging rail authorities. His confederation programme distinguishes the right to cross a pass from grazing rights and political jurisdiction. The University register proposes a connection to Nine-Pass Peace. The capacity and timing depend on the event testimony.
sources: Author’s revised Early Age of Machinery placement and political roles, 2026-11-24.
